## Scheme

Name of the scheme, and the ministry or department that runs it.

## Official sources

Link the official source documents (`gov.in` / `nic.in`) for the scheme and its latest amendment order. A scheme can only be added when its amendment lineage can be verified from official documents - see `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

- Scheme document:
- Latest amendment order:
- Amendment date:

## What citizens ask about it

One or two example questions this scheme would answer (eligibility, benefit amount, how to apply).

## Lineage notes

Anything that makes this scheme tricky: superseded orders, renamed schemes, state-level variations. If an amendment survives only on an unofficial mirror, say so - it blocks ingestion until verified.
